text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience, and I’d love to support your Anime quiz channel as a community manager.

I can help write engaging community posts about anime and quiz content, reply to viewer comments in a friendly and consistent tone, gather HD image sources for videos, and draft quiz shorts scripts for your editor. I’m comfortable working with content-heavy, audience-facing tasks and keeping things organized.

One relevant project I’ve built was a live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight, where I created a dispatcher map showing every truck’s position and ETA as GPS pings arrived. It tracked 1,800 trucks live and kept updates under 2 seconds from ping to screen.

I’d be glad to bring the same reliability and attention to detail to your channel.
